name: 911 Runtime Estimator
description: Scans a ROOT directory of order folders, reads each nest's work-package PDF (thickness, pieces, material, size, mil spec) and its batch list, computes a per-nest plate-cutting time estimate, and writes ONE consolidated Excel workbook: a flat data table across all orders plus a pivot-style summary keyed by nest number. Prompts for the ROOT directory at runtime.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: Output Directory (optional)
fields.description: Where to save the consolidated estimate workbook. Leave blank to save inside the ROOT directory you pick at runtime.
